notes: Objective posted as 'SYCFA/TUPINTU' (Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe). The strategy names the starting Effects as There Is No Try/Oppressive Enforcement, Secret Plans and Mobilization Points, with Prepared Defenses; all are in the posted list and count toward the 60. Several Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set.

Secret Plans is an Effect in 2001 (not a Defensive Shield); 'Oppressive Enforcement/There is No Try' dested There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement; 'Ghhhk/Those Rebels Won't Escape Us' and 'Ommni Box/It's Worse' the combo interrupts.

Systems dested to the Dark printings: Alderaan (Dark), Endor (Dark), Kashyyyk (Dark), Sullust (Dark), Asteroid Field (Dark); 'Death Star Docking Bay' = Death Star: Docking Bay 327 (Dark); 'Death Star War Room' Death Star: War Room.

Posted 'U-3PO' dested U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio); 'Merrejk' Commander Merrejk; 'Emperors Shield' The Emperor's Shield; 'Dreadnaught' Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser; 'SFS L-s 9.3 Laser Cannons (from SE)' SFS L-s9.3 Laser Cannons; 'Flawless Marksmenship' Flawless Marksmanship; 'Twilek Advisor' Twi'lek Advisor; 'Short Range Fighters' Short-range Fighters.
Posted 'Grabber x2' kept as written (UNKNOWN): it names no card, and Allegations Of Corruption (Coruscant, August 2001) was not out in March 2001.
The Effects header says 10 but 11 Effects are listed; total is 60 as published. 'Fantasy DPC' in the title is a fantasy league, not a tournament.

The strategy suggests pulling the Emperors for another Presence Of The Force and another Ghhhk combo; his later post 'Why I am 0 points in Fantasy Vegas DPC' (DeckTech 14764, 22 March 2001) is that revision (also Main Course in place of Asteroid Field), so this is an earlier version, not a repost.
The strategy mentions spies, which are not in the posted list.
